notes: Risk scoring: feature prep, weighted composite risk score from 5 component scores, risk-tier classification, top-two risk-driver ranking via array scan, PROC FREQ tier distribution. Reads an 80-row sample of the repo's own stg_risk_factors staging CSV (inlined, active customers only). Composite/tier/driver logic unchanged. The upstream PROC LOGISTIC step is omitted: every customer in the staging data has payment_late_cnt=0, so DEFAULT_FLAG is single-class and the model is not fittable on this slice (PROBABILITY_OF_DEFAULT coalesces to 0 exactly as upstream). The array driver-list uses an intermediate INV_BUREAU variable in place of an inline expression element.
